notApplicable.checkable-size: CheckableTag exposes a single chip geometry. The size axis changes Tag's public small/medium/large values only.
notApplicable.error: Tag's error is a semantic preset visible in every frame rather than a validation state.
notApplicable.loading: Neither Tag nor CheckableTag exposes an asynchronous loading protocol.
notApplicable.expanded: Tags do not own a popup; close and selection are separate real interactions.
